changementEmail.envoiImpossible: The code could not be sent right now.

supprVelo.intro: Select the bikes to remove from your profile:

suppressionCompte.chapeau: Deletion is immediate and permanent. Nothing can be restored afterwards.
suppressionCompte.ligneCompte: Your account and your email address
suppressionCompte.ligneIdentite: Your name, date of birth and fitness level
suppressionCompte.ligneTrajets: Your routes, their tracks and your history
suppressionCompte.ligneBadges: Your badges and your sign-in sessions
suppressionCompte.conserve: Your hazard reports stay visible to other cyclists, but they are no longer linked to your account.
suppressionCompte.acquittement: I understand that my account and my data will be deleted with no way to restore them.

auteursBloques.intro: You no longer see reports from these people. Unblocking them brings their reports back to the map.
auteursBloques.erreurChargement: The list could not be loaded.

newsletter.recapDescription: A round-up of your rides, kilometres and badges at the start of each month, and at the start of the year.
newsletter.note: Emails tied to your account — verification, password reset — do not depend on this setting and will keep being sent.
newsletter.erreur: The setting could not be saved. Try again in a moment.
